title: Biblical Meditation
definition: Biblical Meditation is the prayerful dwelling on God's Word so truth shapes the mind, heart, worship, and obedience.
summary: Meditation slows the heart before Scripture and helps truth take root.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the living Word to whom Scripture points and through whom believers receive wisdom and life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Biblical Meditation describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is meditation slows the heart before scripture and helps truth take root.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Biblical Meditation teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let biblical meditation shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
